purpose: Prevent future sessions from mistaking early scaffolding for permanent ontology.
hard_law: Do not treat seed cues as evidence.
Do not publish private testimony without consent, de-identification, withdrawal, and harm review.
Do not make clinical, legal, emergency, funeral, financial, benefits, ritual, or therapy advice surfaces without appropriate domain review and even then keep them orientation-only where relevant.
Do not expose suicide means, romanticizing detail, or method pathways.
Do not expose children’s words or pediatric details without highest-gate review; many such materials may never become public.
Do not extract restricted cultural or Indigenous knowledge; communities set terms or decline representation.
Do not turn public visibility into consent.
Do not build death prediction, eligibility, insurance, triage, or time-left tools.
Do not make voyeurism, spectacle, or good-death aesthetics the public reward.
Do not let fieldwork protocols harden into extraction scripts; each role, community, and contributor may require a different path.
soft_scaffolds_future_sessions_may_revis: the current six major axes and their subdivisions
the three-surface model of lay/practitioner/provenance views
current file names and ledgers except where needed for continuity
whether glossary terms stay secondary to witnessed moments
how many records belong in quarantine before first public release
which review packets are grouped together
the exact wording of codenames, clusters, and atlas categories
fieldwork protocol order, forms, consent menu wording, and interview question bank
explicit_permissions_for_future_operator: Write a counter-memo if the current telos feels too narrow.
Pause record growth and improve foundations, review, retrieval, or public rendering.
Add new axes such as sensory channel, institutional power, body state, object/material culture, technology, weather/season, language register, or absence/no-witness.
Split subcorpora when a domain deserves its own cube, for example pediatric dying, grief, body work, caregiving, or disaster death.
Downgrade, quarantine, merge, or delete records if they overclaim or encode unsafe assumptions.
Invent new surfaces for educators, artists, public-health scholars, chaplains, children’s caregivers, or people facing their own death, as long as gates remain intact.
Use negative-space records for what is unknown, restricted, refused, hidden, unrecovered, or institutionally opaque.
Disagree with previous revisions in writing; preserve the disagreement as part of the cube.
danger_signs_that_the_cube_is_too_constr: operators only add more records because the previous revision added records
quarantine becomes a warehouse rather than a review state
axes become boxes that prevent noticing a more important structure
ethics gates become an excuse to never think about hard domains
public-source summaries replace the oral craft the seed actually asks for
language becomes sanitized and loses smell, sound, anger, money, shame, humor, bureaucracy, and bodily detail
future sessions treat this revision as doctrine rather than invitation
A consent form exists, so operators start collecting grief before testing data custody, stopping, compensation, and withdrawal.
safe_flexibility_rule: The archive should be rigid about consent, evidence, non-voyeurism, sovereignty, and non-advice; it should be loose about ontology, interface, sequence, prose form, and research imagination.
